description_en: Queries the content of a log file for a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment
description_zh: 显示一个HPO实验指定log的内容
kebab_example: aliyun paiautoml list-hpo-experiment-logs --experiment-id abcde --log-name nnimanager.log --page-number 1 --page-size 40 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHpoExperimentLogs

parameters.description_en: The ID of the HPO experiment.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the HPO experiment
parameters.name: experiment_id

parameters.description_en: The name of the log. Valid values: nnimanager.log and dispatcher.log.
parameters.help_en: The name of the log. Valid values: nnimanager.log and dispatcher.log
parameters.name: log_name

parameters.description_en: The page number. Page start from page 1. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned.
parameters.description_zh: 页码。起始值：1。不填则返回log文件里所有内容。
parameters.help_en: The page number. Page start from page 1. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
parameters.help_zh: 页码。起始值：1。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned.
parameters.description_zh: 每页包含的日志行数。不填则返回log文件里所有内容。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
parameters.help_zh: 每页包含的日志行数。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
parameters.name: page_size
